display_zh: 火柴人 3 史前手绘黑色幽默

lens_aspect.notes: 手绘 2D 线稿，不规则轮廓

rules: 16:9: lateral staging, stable screen direction, reserve subtitle-safe space
9:16: re-block for depth and vertical readability, keep layout simple
cast layout stated explicitly; forbid unintended duplicates
composition.zh: 横屏横向调度，竖屏重构纵深；明确声明角色布局

rules: earthy prehistoric environments with warm fire accents
subtle paper texture and irregular outlines belong to this style
no photorealistic skin, no glossy 3D characters, no modern studio UI
lighting.zh: 史前大地环境 + 暖火点缀 + 纸张纹理

rules: white filled round heads, thin black stick limbs, expressive simple cartoon eyes/brows/mouths
animal-hide clothing, earthy ochre/brown scenery, small warm fire accents
maximum three saturated accent colors named with ordinary words
no technical color notation (hex, RGB, Pantone) in generation prompts
color.zh: 白填充圆头 + 黑线四肢 + 兽皮服装 + 大地赭棕场景 + 暖火

rules: explicit timed physical beats with prop ownership: state where an object starts, who hands it over and where it ends
prefer clear action, expressive reactions, a motivated camera cut and synchronized SFX over irrelevant spectacle
deadpan glance or held expression of roughly half a second to two seconds can be the payoff
motion.zh: 计时物理节拍 + 道具归属 + 面无表情停顿可作为笑点

rhythm.cut_rule: premise/conflict → tempting solution/escalation → reversal/callback; ~18-25 spoken words per clip; do not force a comment question into a visual punchline
rhythm.zh: 铺垫→升级→反转回调；每段约 18-25 词

signature.en: crude hand-drawn 2D black outlines, white filled round heads, thin black stick limbs, expressive simple cartoon eyes/brows/mouths
signature.zh: 手绘黑色轮廓 + 白填充圆头 + 黑线四肢 + 简单卡通表情

signature.en: animal-hide costumes, earthy ochre/brown prehistoric scenery, small warm fire accents, subtle paper texture and irregular outlines
signature.zh: 兽皮服装 + 大地赭棕史前场景 + 暖火 + 纸张纹理

signature.en: story-specific casting with compact cast cards (role, age range, proportions, hair, facial marks, costume silhouette, one recognizable accessory)
signature.zh: 按故事定制的角色卡（身份/年龄/比例/发型/面部特征/服装轮廓/配饰）

negative: visible words, letters, numbers, captions, subtitles, interface copy, logos, watermarks

anime_safe.notes: 手绘 2D 线稿，与非写实画风兼容

rules: re-block for depth and vertical readability
keep layout simple; state cast layout explicitly
keep overlay text in the interface-safe upper/lower band
vertical_9x16.note: 竖屏重构纵深而非改比例标签

grade.description: earthy ochre grade, warm fire accents, subtle paper texture feel

line_weight: crude hand-drawn 2D black outlines, irregular stroke
character_dna: A prehistoric stickman figure with a white filled round head, thin black stick limbs, expressive simple cartoon eyes/brows/mouth, animal-hide clothing, earthy ochre/brown prehistoric scenery, subtle paper texture and irregular outlines.
